ModDescription: Edits the traits a sigil carries - the game's own data calls them skills (table skill_status), which is what the old name referred to. Ships no .tbl: the table is read from the game archive, and only the rows you name are changed. SigilEdit.exe writes %APPDATA%\GBFR.SigilEdit\Config.json and signals a named event, and the running game re-applies the list to the table it already has in memory.
